cases.refreshed: The Santa Teresa Book Club discusses works of general interest, fiction, or historical fiction. The club meets from 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. on the second Thursday January through November. Meetings are usually held in the Community Room at the Santa Teresa Branch Library in San Jose. The book club offers participants the opportunity to log in through Zoom and attend virtually. The link will be sent out 24 hours before the meeting starts. If you do not receive the invite, please check your junk mail folder first and then contact the librarian listed on this event for assistance. Upcoming book discussions include: July 9: Anxious People by Fredrik Backman; August 13: Shelterwood by Lisa Wingate; September 10: Theo of Golden by Allen Levi; October 8: The Briar Club by Kate Quinn; November 12: Grown Women by Sarai Johnson.

cases.refreshed: This event happens on the third Wednesday of every month. This month we are creating our own tiled coasters using mosaic tiles. This craft uses glue, tiles, wooden boards and cork sheets to make colorful and unique coasters you can gift this holiday season or keep to decorate your home with functional beauty. All supplies and tools are provided by the library. Sensory and accessibility notes: There will be some strong smells of glue, and the sound of fans used for ventilation purposes. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.

cases.refreshed: Start off the Thanksgiving vacation with a fun puzzle competition! We will have a timed puzzle challenge with teams of 3-4 to see who can assemble the puzzle fastest! Winners get a prize. Only one registration per team is needed. Please pre-register your team if you are hoping to compete! Competition space is limited. There will be a space for a non-competitive puzzle and socializing. Snacks for everyone are included. If you are just here for the vibes there is no need to register! For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.
